Groundwater Rule.name: Groundwater Rule
Groundwater Rule.plain: A requirement for systems using groundwater to identify and correct faecal contamination risks. A violation usually means required monitoring or corrective action was not completed.

Total Haloacetic Acids (HAA5).plain: Like trihalomethanes, haloacetic acids form when disinfectant reacts with organic matter in the water. They are a side-effect of disinfection, not an added ingredient.
Total Haloacetic Acids (HAA5).effect: Some people who drink water containing haloacetic acids in excess of the maximum contaminant level over many years may have an increased risk of getting cancer.
Total Haloacetic Acids (HAA5).source: U.S. EPA, mandatory health effects language — Haloacetic Acids
Total Haloacetic Acids (HAA5).name: Total Haloacetic Acids (HAA5)

Revised Total Coliform Rule.plain: Coliforms are bacteria that are mostly harmless in themselves. They are measured as an indicator: if they are present, the system may be open to something that is not harmless.
Revised Total Coliform Rule.effect: Coliforms are bacteria that are naturally present in the environment and are used as an indicator that other, potentially harmful, waterborne pathogens may be present or that a potential pathway exists through which contamination may enter the drinking water distribution system.
Revised Total Coliform Rule.source: U.S. EPA, mandatory health effects language — Revised Total Coliform Rule
Revised Total Coliform Rule.who: A warning sign rather than a harm in itself.
Revised Total Coliform Rule.name: Revised Total Coliform Rule

TTHM.plain: Trihalomethanes are not added to water. They form when the chlorine used to disinfect it reacts with natural organic matter already present. They are a by-product of making water safe from bacteria.
TTHM.effect: Some people who drink water containing trihalomethanes in excess of the maximum contaminant level over many years could experience problems with their liver, kidneys, or central nervous system, and may have an increased risk of getting cancer.
TTHM.source: U.S. EPA, mandatory health effects language — Total Trihalomethanes
TTHM.name: TTHM

Lead and Copper Rule.name: Lead and Copper Rule
Lead and Copper Rule.plain: The rule governing lead and copper monitoring and corrosion control. A violation is often procedural — a missed sampling round or a late report.
